Johnston's unflinching film is a personal and emotional journey that looks at love, marriage, family, and commitment, as he explores the effect his parents' marriage has had on his romantic ideals. programme.desc: For more than four decades, the Britannia served as the floating embassy of the British Empire, a royal retreat and a family 'love boat'. This film delves deep into the secrets of the ship and uses previously unknown archive material to tell the story of the 'power and magic' associated with the royal yacht. To this day, the 126-metre-long state ship is considered the mother of all large yachts and an extraordinary style icon.

As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth, Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better. Stars Kathy Bates and Jessica Tandy.

Thus begins a treacherous 6000-kilometre trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. They have little food and few supplies, but together, they must withstand nature at is most extreme. Directed by Peter Weir and stars Jim Sturgess, Colin Farrell and Ed Harris.

Stars Hilary Swank, Helena Bonham-Carter and Jeffrey Tambor.

programme.title: My Sailor, My Love
programme.desc: Howard, a retired sailor and widow, lives in a house by the sea. His adult daughter Grace hires a carer for her father, a lady in her mature years, Annie. Recluse and stubborn, Howard rejects Annie’s company, but eventually opens his heart and gives his final love a chance. Grace has her own crisis to unravel and finds her father’s romance difficult. Her father’s new love reminds her of the affection she missed, as a child and now again as an adult. Annie must face the complex father-daughter relationship, while Howard and Grace must realise their own imperfections.

programme.title: The Dream Of Love
programme.desc: An autobiographical journey for filmmaker Lawrence Johnston, who grew up as one of six siblings to his Aboriginal father Colin and non-Indigenous mother, Gloria. Their marriage was a tempestuous one, that included physical and emotional abuse. Johnston's unflinching film is a personal and emotional journey that looks at love, marriage, family, and commitment, as he explores the effect his parents' marriage has had on his romantic ideals. His debut feature film Life won the FIPRESCI International Critics Prize at the 1996 Toronto Film Festival and was nominated for four Australian Film Institute Awards and four Australian Film Critics Circle Awards including Best Actor and Best Screenplay. programme.title: Britannia: The Queen's Ship
programme.desc: For more than four decades, the Britannia served as the floating embassy of the British Empire, a royal retreat and a family 'love boat'. This film delves deep into the secrets of the ship and uses previously unknown archive material to tell the story of the 'power and magic' associated with the royal yacht. To this day, the 126-metre-long state ship is considered the mother of all large yachts and an extraordinary style icon.

programme.title: Roman Holiday

As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Farrar and Jean Simmons.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: During one of housewife Evelyn Couch's nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode, a colourful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth, Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better. Stars Kathy Bates and Jessica Tandy.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Inspired by an incredible true story, The Way Back begins in 1940 when seven prisoners attempt the impossible: escape from a brutal Siberian gulag. Thus begins a treacherous 6000-kilometre trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. They have little food and few supplies, but together, they must withstand nature at is most extreme. Directed by Peter Weir and stars Jim Sturgess, Colin Farrell and Ed Harris.

programme.title: 55 Steps
programme.desc: When patients' rights lawyer Colette Hughes goes to meet her new client, Eleanor Riese, a patient in the psychiatric unit of a San Francisco hospital, she has no idea that besides taking on an uphill legal battle to improve treatment for mental patients in hospitals, she is meeting a woman who will make it her mission to transform Colette's workaholic life. Stars Hilary Swank, Helena Bonham-Carter and Jeffrey Tambor.

programme.title: My Sailor, My Love
programme.desc: Howard, a retired sailor and widow, lives in a house by the sea. His adult daughter Grace hires a carer for her father, a lady in her mature years, Annie. Recluse and stubborn, Howard rejects Annie’s company, but eventually opens his heart and gives his final love a chance. Grace has her own crisis to unravel and finds her father’s romance difficult. Her father’s new love reminds her of the affection she missed, as a child and now again as an adult. Annie must face the complex father-daughter relationship, while Howard and Grace must realise their own imperfections.

Johnston's unflinching film is a personal and emotional journey that looks at love, marriage, family, and commitment, as he explores the effect his parents' marriage has had on his romantic ideals. His debut feature film Life won the FIPRESCI International Critics Prize at the 1996 Toronto Film Festival and was nominated for four Australian Film Institute Awards and four Australian Film Critics Circle Awards including Best Actor and Best Screenplay. programme.desc: Portugal managed to get through all of World War II without firing a single shot. Caught in a vice between the Axis and the Allies, Antonio Salazar, the country's strongman, used every trick in the book to get his country through unscathed. In this war of nerves in which anything went, the Portuguese dictator took brilliant advantage of the only weapon available to maintain his country's independence: neutrality.

programme.title: Britannia: The Queen's Ship
programme.desc: For more than four decades, the Britannia served as the floating embassy of the British Empire, a royal retreat and a family 'love boat'. This film delves deep into the secrets of the ship and uses previously unknown archive material to tell the story of the 'power and magic' associated with the royal yacht. To this day, the 126-metre-long state ship is considered the mother of all large yachts and an extraordinary style icon.

programme.title: Call Me Kate

Prone to anxiety and paranoia, he visits his longtime therapist who prepares him for his journey to visit his mother. But mayhem ensues on the eve of Beau’s departure, spinning his life in a surreal new direction.

programme.title: Roman Holiday

programme.title: Black Narcissus

As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Farrar and Jean Simmons.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: During one of housewife Evelyn Couch's nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode, a colourful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth, Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better. Stars Kathy Bates and Jessica Tandy.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Inspired by an incredible true story, The Way Back begins in 1940 when seven prisoners attempt the impossible: escape from a brutal Siberian gulag. Thus begins a treacherous 6000-kilometre trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. They have little food and few supplies, but together, they must withstand nature at is most extreme. Directed by Peter Weir and stars Jim Sturgess, Colin Farrell and Ed Harris.

programme.title: 55 Steps
programme.desc: When patients' rights lawyer Colette Hughes goes to meet her new client, Eleanor Riese, a patient in the psychiatric unit of a San Francisco hospital, she has no idea that besides taking on an uphill legal battle to improve treatment for mental patients in hospitals, she is meeting a woman who will make it her mission to transform Colette's workaholic life. Stars Hilary Swank, Helena Bonham-Carter and Jeffrey Tambor.

programme.title: My Sailor, My Love
programme.desc: Howard, a retired sailor and widow, lives in a house by the sea. His adult daughter Grace hires a carer for her father, a lady in her mature years, Annie. Recluse and stubborn, Howard rejects Annie’s company, but eventually opens his heart and gives his final love a chance. Grace has her own crisis to unravel and finds her father’s romance difficult. Her father’s new love reminds her of the affection she missed, as a child and now again as an adult. Annie must face the complex father-daughter relationship, while Howard and Grace must realise their own imperfections.

programme.sub-title: Lisbon And Ww2: Spies, Gold And Diplomacy
programme.desc: Portugal managed to get through all of World War II without firing a single shot. Caught in a vice between the Axis and the Allies, Antonio Salazar, the country's strongman, used every trick in the book to get his country through unscathed. In this war of nerves in which anything went, the Portuguese dictator took brilliant advantage of the only weapon available to maintain his country's independence: neutrality.

programme.title: Prince William: A Life In Pictures

programme.title: Britannia: The Queen's Ship
programme.desc: For more than four decades, the Britannia served as the floating embassy of the British Empire, a royal retreat and a family 'love boat'. This film delves deep into the secrets of the ship and uses previously unknown archive material to tell the story of the 'power and magic' associated with the royal yacht. To this day, the 126-metre-long state ship is considered the mother of all large yachts and an extraordinary style icon.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: The ultimate, definitive film of Katharine Hepburn, brought to life using original unheard sound recordings, letters and private interviews and blending poetic and dreamlike dramatic reconstructions to bring to life Katharine's memories and the moments that defined her.

programme.title: Those Who Stayed
programme.desc: Yura is homeless living in the car with his 10-year-old son after fleeing from the war. When the fighting had caught up to him, he decides to stand his ground.

programme.title: Those Who Stayed
programme.desc: Klaus is a young German surgeon. When the war starts, he drives to Kyiv to whisk away his Ukrainian girlfriend. But she refuses to flee, so Hans also stays, inspired by the volunteer movement, until one day he finds himself heavily-wounded.

programme.title: Beau Is Afraid
programme.desc: Beau lives alone in a downtown apartment where every moment is a waking nightmare. Prone to anxiety and paranoia, he visits his longtime therapist who prepares him for his journey to visit his mother. But mayhem ensues on the eve of Beau’s departure, spinning his life in a surreal new direction.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: A young princess (Audrey Hepburn), tired of her constraints, runs off with a U.S. newsman (Gregory Peck) in Rome.

programme.title: Black Narcissus
programme.desc: This Powell and Pressburger classic is set in a community of nuns high in the Himalayas. Their spiritual aims are hampered by the arrival of a beautiful girl and a young general. As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Farrar and Jean Simmons.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: During one of housewife Evelyn Couch's nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode, a colourful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth, Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better. Stars Kathy Bates and Jessica Tandy.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Inspired by an incredible true story, The Way Back begins in 1940 when seven prisoners attempt the impossible: escape from a brutal Siberian gulag. Thus begins a treacherous 6000-kilometre trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. They have little food and few supplies, but together, they must withstand nature at is most extreme. Directed by Peter Weir and stars Jim Sturgess, Colin Farrell and Ed Harris.

programme.title: 55 Steps
programme.desc: When patients' rights lawyer Colette Hughes goes to meet her new client, Eleanor Riese, a patient in the psychiatric unit of a San Francisco hospital, she has no idea that besides taking on an uphill legal battle to improve treatment for mental patients in hospitals, she is meeting a woman who will make it her mission to transform Colette's workaholic life. Stars Hilary Swank, Helena Bonham-Carter and Jeffrey Tambor.

programme.title: My Sailor, My Love
programme.desc: Howard, a retired sailor and widow, lives in a house by the sea. His adult daughter Grace hires a carer for her father, a lady in her mature years, Annie. Recluse and stubborn, Howard rejects Annie’s company, but eventually opens his heart and gives his final love a chance. Grace has her own crisis to unravel and finds her father’s romance difficult. Her father’s new love reminds her of the affection she missed, as a child and now again as an adult. Annie must face the complex father-daughter relationship, while Howard and Grace must realise their own imperfections.
